title: 焚化煙氣袋濾除塵~Fabric-filter flue-gas cleaning
focus: 由濾餅、配流與差壓理解袋濾除塵與破袋診斷~Understand bag filtration and failure diagnosis through cake, flow distribution and differential pressure
summary: 本課以「由濾餅、配流與差壓理解袋濾除塵與破袋診斷」為主軸，依序處理入口粉塵負荷、濾餅累積與阻力、出口濃度與去除率、破袋事件的時間延遲、分室診斷可信度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Understand bag filtration and failure diagnosis through cake, flow distribution and differential pressure, progressing through Inlet dust loading, Cake accumulation and resistance, Outlet concentration and removal, Timing of a bag-failure signal, Confidence in compartment diagnosis. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 入口粉塵負荷~Inlet dust loading
units.mechanism: 入口濃度與實際處理氣量共同決定濾袋每天承受的粉塵，不只看濃度百分比。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Inlet concentration and gas flow jointly determine dust presented to the bags; concentration alone is insufficient. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「入口粉塵負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Inlet dust loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「入口粉塵負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Inlet dust loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 濾布面積與過濾風速~Cloth area and filtration velocity
units.mechanism: 計算在線面積時扣除停用濾室，並對照分室氣流而非假定均勻。 過濾風速由實際氣量除以可用布面積；隔離一室時其餘濾袋負荷會上升。~Subtract isolated compartments from online area and compare compartment flows rather than assuming uniformity. Air-to-cloth velocity is actual flow divided by available area; isolating one compartment increases loading on the others.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣體流量 Q=60 m³/min；有效濾布面積 A=120 m²。公式 v=Q/A，計算得 0.5 m/min。適用邊界：平均配流近似且氣量與溫壓一致，不代表濾料容許值。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas flow Q=60 m³/min; effective cloth area A=120 m². Formula v=Q/A gives 0.5 m/min. Applicability: Mean-flow approximation at consistent gas conditions, not a permitted fabric loading.
units.verify: 針對「濾布面積與過濾風速」，核對在線濾袋數、實際氣量與分室差壓，辨識局部超載。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Cloth area and filtration velocity, Check online bag count, actual gas flow and compartment pressure drop to identify local overloading. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把停用濾袋計入面積，會低估在線風速。 在「濾布面積與過濾風速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Counting unavailable bags understates online filtration velocity. Mark where this error can enter the Cloth area and filtration velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 停用一室濾袋不會改變其他室的過濾風速。~Taking one compartment offline cannot change filtration velocity elsewhere.
units.practice: 只將可用面積 A 降為 100 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.5 變成 0.6 m/min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Reduce only available area A to 100 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.5 to 0.6 m/min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 濾餅累積與阻力~Cake accumulation and resistance
units.mechanism: 濾餅能捕捉細粒，也增加阻力；清灰需求需從差壓與出口一起判讀。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~The dust cake captures fine particles while adding resistance; interpret cleaning need using both pressure drop and outlet data. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「濾餅累積與阻力」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Cake accumulation and resistance, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「濾餅累積與阻力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Cake accumulation and resistance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 清灰週期與能耗~Cleaning cycles and energy
units.mechanism: 過度清灰會耗能並擾動濾餅，不足清灰會堵塞；在模擬中比較兩種極端。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。~Over-cleaning consumes energy and disrupts cake; under-cleaning causes blockage. Compare both extremes in simulation. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
units.verify: 針對「清灰週期與能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Cleaning cycles and energy, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「清灰週期與能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Cleaning cycles and energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 風機功率只與風量有關，與管路阻力無關。~Fan power depends only on flow and not on duct resistance.
units.practice: 只將 Δp 改成 1800 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 4.5 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δp to 1800 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 4.5 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 出口濃度與去除率~Outlet concentration and removal
units.mechanism: 出口濃度是直接量測，去除率需配對入口；兩者不可互相取代。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。~Outlet concentration is directly measured, while removal needs matched inlet data; neither replaces the other. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
units.verify: 針對「出口濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Outlet concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「出口濃度與去除率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Outlet concentration and removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率很高就能證明出口濃度符合任何排放標準。~High removal efficiency proves compliance with every outlet-emission limit.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 溫壓乾濕基與氧校正~Reference conditions and oxygen correction
units.mechanism: 保留原始報表與校正欄位，避免在溫度或含濕變化時錯判效能。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。~Retain raw and normalized fields to avoid false performance changes when temperature or moisture changes. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
units.verify: 針對「溫壓乾濕基與氧校正」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reference conditions and oxygen correction, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「溫壓乾濕基與氧校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Reference conditions and oxygen correction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氧校正能消除任何煙道漏氣與取樣代表性的問題。~Oxygen correction eliminates every leakage and sampling-representativeness problem.
units.practice: 只將量測 O₂ 改成 12%，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45.4545 變成 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only measured O₂ to 12%, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 45.4545 to 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 破袋事件的時間延遲~Timing of a bag-failure signal
units.mechanism: 粉塵監測與清灰訊號需扣除取樣傳輸延遲，才能建立合理的事件先後。 輸送延遲會把監測訊號與製程事件錯開，分析前須對齊時間。~Align dust monitoring and cleaning signals for sampling delay before inferring event order. Transport delay shifts monitoring signals relative to process events; align time before interpretation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：取樣管容積 V=2 L；流量 q=0.5 L/min。公式 t=V/q，計算得 4 min。適用邊界：理想置換延遲，未含混合、吸附與分析儀響應時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Sampling-line volume V=2 L; flow q=0.5 L/min. Formula t=V/q gives 4 min. Applicability: Ideal displacement delay without mixing, adsorption or analyzer response time.
units.verify: 針對「破袋事件的時間延遲」，以安全參考訊號或離線脈衝重播測全系統響應，不只使用分析儀規格。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Timing of a bag-failure signal, Use a safe reference signal or offline pulse replay to measure whole-system response, not analyzer specifications alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管線冷凝或吸附會造成較長且不對稱的拖尾。 在「破袋事件的時間延遲」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Condensation or adsorption in tubing causes longer asymmetric tails. Mark where this error can enter the Timing of a bag-failure signal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 分析儀更新每秒一次就代表取樣點到畫面只延遲一秒。~One-second analyzer updates imply only one-second source-to-display delay.
units.practice: 只將 q 改成 0.8 L/min，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 2.5 min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only q to 0.8 L/min, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 2.5 min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 監測失效與缺測~Monitor failure and data gaps
units.mechanism: 高粉塵或凝結時儀器容易失效，缺值不應變成低排放證據。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Instruments can fail during high dust or condensation; missing values are not evidence of low emissions. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「監測失效與缺測」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Monitor failure and data gaps, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「監測失效與缺測」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Monitor failure and data gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 分室診斷可信度~Confidence in compartment diagnosis
units.mechanism: 比較差壓、粉塵訊號與查漏證據，明確標示哪一項尚不足以定位破袋。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Compare pressure, dust signals and leak-test evidence and identify which observations cannot yet localize a failed bag. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「分室診斷可信度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Confidence in compartment diagnosis, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「分室診斷可信度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Confidence in compartment diagnosis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 維修隔離與備援容量~Maintenance isolation and backup capacity
units.mechanism: 模擬隔離一室後的風速和處理能力，記錄維修期間的實際可用狀態。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Simulate velocity and capacity after isolating one compartment and record actual availability during maintenance. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「維修隔離與備援容量」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Maintenance isolation and backup capacity, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「維修隔離與備援容量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Maintenance isolation and backup capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
